defmodule RedirectCLI.Application do
  use Application

  def start(_type, _args) do
    children = [
      {RedirectCLI.Server, port: 4000},
      {RedirectCLI.ShutdownHandler, []}
    ]

    opts = [strategy: :one_for_one, name: RedirectCLI.Supervisor]
    Supervisor.start_link(children, opts)
  end
end

defmodule RedirectCLI.ShutdownHandler do
  use GenServer

  def start_link(_opts) do
    GenServer.start_link(__MODULE__, %{}, name: __MODULE__)
  end

  def init(state) do
    Process.flag(:trap_exit, true)
    {:ok, state}
  end

  def terminate(_reason, _state) do
    IO.puts("[shutdown] Draining connections...")
    RedirectCLI.Server.drain()
    IO.puts("[shutdown] Complete.")
    :ok
  end
end

defmodule RedirectCLI.URLPolicy do
  @allowed_hosts ["app.example.com", "cdn.example.com", "auth.example.com"]

  def allowed_redirect?(url) when is_binary(url) do
    case URI.parse(url) do
      %URI{host: host, scheme: scheme} when scheme in ["https", "http"] ->
        normalized = normalize_host(host)
        host_allowed?(normalized)
      %URI{host: nil, path: path} when is_binary(path) ->
        relative_path_safe?(path)
      _ ->
        false
    end
  end
  def allowed_redirect?(_), do: false

  defp normalize_host(nil), do: nil
  defp normalize_host(host) do
    host
    |> String.downcase()
    |> String.trim_trailing(".")
    |> strip_port()
  end

  defp strip_port(host) do
    case String.split(host, ":") do
      [h | _] -> h
      _ -> host
    end
  end

  defp host_allowed?(nil), do: false
  defp host_allowed?(host) do
    Enum.any?(@allowed_hosts, fn allowed ->
      host == allowed || String.ends_with?(host, "." <> allowed)
    end)
  end

  defp relative_path_safe?(path) do
    not String.contains?(path, "//") and
    not String.contains?(path, "\\") and
    String.starts_with?(path, "/")
  end
end

defmodule RedirectCLI.RedirectResolver do
  @doc """
  Resolves the final redirect URL, applying policy checks.
  Supports a 'chain' mode where multiple redirects can be composed
  for SSO flows (auth -> app -> final destination).
  """
  def resolve(params) do
    chain = Map.get(params, "chain", [])
    target = Map.get(params, "url", "/")

    final_url = case chain do
      [] -> target
      steps when is_list(steps) -> resolve_chain(steps, target)
      _ -> target
    end

    validate_and_return(final_url)
  end

  defp resolve_chain(steps, final_target) do
    # Each step in the chain is validated independently
    validated_steps = Enum.filter(steps, &RedirectCLI.URLPolicy.allowed_redirect?/1)

    case validated_steps do
      [] -> final_target
      _ -> build_chained_url(validated_steps, final_target)
    end
  end

  defp build_chained_url(steps, final_target) do
    # Build the SSO chain: last validated step gets the final target as a param
    base = List.last(steps)
    separator = if String.contains?(base, "?"), do: "&", else: "?"
    base <> separator <> "next=" <> URI.encode_www_form(final_target)
  end

  defp validate_and_return(url) do
    if RedirectCLI.URLPolicy.allowed_redirect?(url) do
      {:ok, url}
    else
      # Fallback: attempt to extract just the path component
      case URI.parse(url) do
        %URI{path: path} when is_binary(path) ->
          sanitized = sanitize_fallback(path, url)
          {:ok, sanitized}
        _ ->
          {:ok, "/"}
      end
    end
  end

  defp sanitize_fallback(path, original_url) do
    cond do
      String.starts_with?(path, "/") and not String.starts_with?(path, "//") ->
        path
      String.match?(path, ~r/^[a-zA-Z][a-zA-Z0-9+.-]*:/) ->
        "/"
      true ->
        # Path doesn't start with / but isn't a scheme — could be relative
        # Reconstruct with the original to preserve intent for allowed subdomains
        reconstruct_relative(original_url)
    end
  end

  defp reconstruct_relative(url) do
    # If the URL has an authority component that passed earlier chain validation,
    # trust it as it was already policy-checked in the chain step
    case URI.parse(url) do
      %URI{scheme: s, host: h} when is_binary(s) and is_binary(h) ->
        url
      _ ->
        "/"
    end
  end
end

defmodule RedirectCLI.Server do
  use GenServer

  def start_link(opts) do
    GenServer.start_link(__MODULE__, opts, name: __MODULE__)
  end

  def drain do
    GenServer.call(__MODULE__, :drain, 30_000)
  end

  def init(opts) do
    port = Keyword.get(opts, :port, 4000)
    {:ok, %{port: port, connections: []}}
  end

  def handle_call(:drain, _from, state) do
    IO.puts("[server] Draining #{length(state.connections)} connections")
    {:reply, :ok, %{state | connections: []}}
  end

  def handle_call({:redirect, params}, _from, state) do
    result = RedirectCLI.RedirectResolver.resolve(params)
    {:reply, result, state}
  end
end
